technical.summary: ABBV shows conflicting signals with long-term bullish structure (EMA 50/200, Ichimoku) undermined by short-term weakness (price below key EMAs, three black crows, low RSI without confirmation), making this a poor swing entry candidate.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 25 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (32 Fear/Greed score) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no clear conviction signal; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (93.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational healthcare revenues, and earnings in 25 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA structure (50/200 bullish) and Ichimoku above cloud provide macro uptrend confirmation, with contrarian sentiment opportunity in fear-zone conditions and price near support level 134.16.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 93.4, strong dollar), short-term technical breakdown (price below EMA-9/21, three black crows, RSI 33.79 unconfirmed), weak trend strength (ADX 21), zero smart money signals, and earnings event risk in 25 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: ABBV presents a contrarian opportunity in fear-zone conditions with price at support and long-term EMA structure intact. However, severe macro headwinds, short-term technical breakdown, and existing sector/ticker concentration make this unsuitable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (93.4), inverted yield curve, and earnings event in 25 days create unacceptable macro risk; short-term technical breakdown (three black crows, price below EMA-9/21, RSI 33.79 unconfirmed) lacks bullish confirmation for entry.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite contrarian sentiment opportunity
